controls.failure_budget: 3 failures per 900 seconds, persistent blocked latch
controls.startup: Docker/mount/image/assets/security/consent before gated queue; every generation needs actual kernel and live network proofs
controls.queue: Owner request AND operator approval; new projects/jobs only; immutable consent generation/input binding; original job permanently excluded; no old-job release/backfill
controls.revocation: SQL row locks serialize visible publication with revoke; short-lived host grant/watchdog terminates processing; private in-flight HTTP upload can finish without publishing a result
controls.retention: Rotating samples/controller/Docker logs, bounded per-generation proofs and persistent cumulative resource accounting

sql.fixtures: Disposable local PostgreSQL/PGMQ metadata fixtures; no model/website acceptance claim

systemd.scope: Isolated syntax/dependency parser only, not actual system-manager/host boot

protected_upload.protection: Permanent exclusion plus exact whole-row preflight/runtime hash; no hosted query or mutation in this preparation
